title: Files a read opens
prompt: This program writes the ten invoice lines shown to a Delta table partitioned by product, counts the files three reads would open, then rewrites the table with at most 2 lines per file. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
path = "/tmp/c2/lines"
invoice_lines.coalesce(1).write.format("delta").partitionBy("product_id").save(path)
table = spark.read.format("delta").load(path)
print(len(table.inputFiles()))
print(len(table.where("product_id = 'PRD-002'").inputFiles()))
print(len(table.where("quantity >= 10").inputFiles()))

(invoice_lines.coalesce(1)
    .write.format("delta")
    .mode("overwrite")
    .partitionBy("product_id")
    .option("maxRecordsPerFile", 2)
    .save(path))
print(len(spark.read.format("delta").load(path).inputFiles()))
hints: One task writes one file for each product it holds. How many products are there?
A condition on the partition column picks folders; on another column, a file is skipped only if its min/max range can't match.
With a cap of 2, a product with three lines needs two files.
